## About
Sauve Automotive was started by father and son Wayne and Sean Sauve after decades of working side by side on cars. After Wayne's passing, Sean carried on his father's legacy with the same honesty and care. You'll find us on Olympia Dr. in Oldcastle, right next door to Devolli's Famous Omelettes.
We service cars, light duty trucks and fleet vehicles. We don't just replace parts. We find out what's really going on, talk through your options with you, and give you a clear picture of what can wait and what needs attention now.
Our customers rate us 4.9 on Google from 46 reviews.

## Services
- Tires: Tire work for cars, light duty trucks and fleet vehicles.
- Brakes: Brake repairs as part of our general repair work.
- Tune ups: Tune ups to keep your vehicle running the way it should.
- Suspension repairs: Suspension repairs for cars and light duty trucks.
- Air conditioning service: Air conditioning service to keep your cabin comfortable.
- Electrical diagnostic and repairs: Sean's specialty. We track down electrical faults others might overlook, on all makes and models.
- Annual inspections and safety inspections: Annual inspections and safety inspections for your vehicle.
- Regular maintenance: Routine maintenance to stay ahead of bigger problems.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: We service cars, light duty trucks and fleet vehicles.

Q: Will you tell me what can wait and what can't?
A: Yes. We discuss your options and give you a clear picture of what might need attention in the future, whether it's work that can wait or something that needs care right away.

Q: When are you open?
A: We're open weekdays, Monday through Friday, and closed on Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 2185 Olympia Dr. in Oldcastle, just minutes from Windsor and right next door to Devolli's Famous Omelettes.
